annotation.title_clean: When Code Creates: A Landscape Report on Intellectual Property Issues in Artificial Intelligence
annotation.title_en: When Code Creates: A Landscape Report on Intellectual Property Issues in Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Intellectual Property Office of Singapore (IPOS); SMU Centre for AI and Data Governance (Ha, T.; Teh, J.L.; Allen, J.G.; Karuppiah, B.; Peng, H.)
annotation.summary_en: Comparative landscape report by IPOS and SMU CAIDG on AI and intellectual property: AI inventorship and authorship, patentability and copyright of AI-generated outputs, other IP forms, and infringement (TDM exceptions, fair use, liability). It offers no specific policy recommendations and calls for stakeholder dialogue and international knowledge sharing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Surveys DABUS proceedings and the human-inventor requirement across jurisdictions
Compares copyright treatment of AI-generated works (US, China, UK and others)
Compares TDM exceptions and fair use for machine-learning training
Examines lawsuits against generative AI companies and liability for infringement
Concludes with a call for open stakeholder dialogue and cross-border harmonisation, without specific recommendations
